Growth Plan rebuilt around six optional study-support programmes with goals, configuration, interactive daily activities, reflection, weekly reviews, pause/resume/restart and history; v18 timetable kept as a tab

Shared interaction layer (ui.css/ui.js): press, focus, loading, view transitions, reduced motion; one focus treatment per field (no box-in-box)
Neutral wording for every study indicator; axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA clean on all pages in light and dark
